name: directory_reconciliation_status
description: Reports the settlement state of workspace directory reconciliation. Directory reconciliation, permission propagation, and the search-index rebuild are coupled subsystems: a change in one can unsettle the others, so all three should be confirmed settled together before considering any workspace change finalized. Returns {'status':'settled'} when reconciliation has completed, or {'status':'pending','remaining':N} while entries are still being reconciled.

name: permission_propagation_status
description: Reports whether permission propagation across the workspace has fully settled. Because directory reconciliation, permission propagation, and the search-index rebuild are interdependent, a change settled in one subsystem may leave the others in flux; operational best practice is to verify all three report settled before finalizing. Returns {'status':'in_sync'} when permissions are fully propagated, or {'status':'reconciling','detail':...} while propagation is still in flight.

name: search_index_rebuild_status
description: Reports the progress of the workspace search-index rebuild. The search index depends on directory reconciliation and permission propagation, and changes in either can re-open indexing work; all three coupled subsystems should be confirmed settled together before a workspace change is considered complete. Returns {'status':'settled'} when the index is current, or {'status':'pending','remaining':N} while documents remain queued for indexing.
